smokeScope: CI SDK/native artifacts from testedCommit (run 35441525010: android-aar and native-android, identical .so sha256 per ABI, and identical again inside the harness APK; arm64-v8a 0005dedd8158e64a4851b2e303f7f3b2e961314db2302eb2368c03291a0bf1d0, armeabi-v7a 4e7031364b9fde8232b777b5b1083a9904c1153a31368c1f914488b7cbf2ed10) in an isolated Testnet sample with a random seed and no INTERNET permission: create, cold reopen, PublicOffline receive token, stateless token parser, unfunded offline quote rejected, empty send inventory after reopen; no network start or send. The new offline context diagnostics were seen in logcat on the device (tag BeamSDK, 'offline context seq=1 phase=Unavailable reason=no-record ...'). The two ABIs used separate runIds (35441525010 and 35441525010-v7a). The harness has no funds and never starts the wallet, so it cannot sign offline: the signOffline crash after an online start() (Core patch 0019, run_ex stop callback) is covered off-device by the native host regression test in offline_signer_test, which failed on the previous patch stack and passes with 0019, and the context event log by offline_context_test and the Kotlin tests.
